synthesis.headline: Management frequently raises guidance and drops targets, while actual verification remains limited by data constraints.

points.text: Management raised AUM growth guidance to 26-27% for FY27, but actual revenue growth is off track at 20.7%.
Several key guidance metrics including gold loan shares, captive book wind down, ROA, and ROE were dropped after initial mentions.
Numerous targets for customer acquisition, branches, and loan volumes are unverifiable due to a lack of reported comparison data.
Annual PAT steadily increased to 19,332.0 crore alongside growing quarterly revenue reaching 24,546.0 crore by Sep 2026.

bull.text: Annual revenue grew consistently up to 81,985.0 crore for Mar 2026, supported by quarterly revenue increases.
Annual profit after tax showed steady positive growth, reaching 19,332.0 crore by Mar 2026.

bear.text: Cash from operations remains heavily negative at -65,790.0 crore for Mar 2026, with poor CFO to PAT ratios.
AUM growth guidance of 26-27% is off track based on current reported revenue growth of 20.7%.

business.what: Bajaj Finance provides diversified financial services, including consumer finance, MSME lending, and rural financing, delivering strong AUM growth and robust profitability.
business.quote: Overall, I would say it is an excellent quarter with strong performance across all key metrics, of AUM, new customer addition, credit cost, profit growth, ROA and ROE.
